**1. I DID NOT CARRY THE PLAN'S EXCLUSIVITY CAVEAT VERBATIM, because it is now false.** The plan says to carry, word for word, "no lock is taken until task-4247169c … lands". That row LANDED — it is the current HEAD, `95384f0c`. Re-measured at `session.rs:136`: `Some(path) => match locks.acquire(path)`, with `Err(error) => Outcome::NotLaunched(refuse_store_lock(wiring, error))`. **The broker now takes the lock and refuses on contention with BROKER_STORE_LOCK.** Also worth knowing: `deadline_ms = request.store_path().is_none().then_some(self.timeout_ms)`, so a store-locked launch runs WITHOUT the idle deadline — the lock bounds it instead of the timer.

Copying the instruction verbatim would have shipped a false statement about production into two downstream rows' comments, which is exactly what the stale-by-default rail exists to prevent — and the rail binds a plan's claims as much as a description's. Corrected caveat in the comment, and it is the version I will hand to task-bd5c2a0e and task-e868ea33 in step 6.

**2. The two modules canonicalise paths with DIFFERENT Node APIs and can disagree on 8.3 volumes.** `project-manager-launch.ts` uses `realpathSync.native` (:174, :179); `project-manager-files.ts` uses `fs/promises realpath` (:85-87, :102-104); those two are known to differ on 8.3 short paths, and `pathKey` (`win32.normalize().toLowerCase()`) case-folds but does not 8.3-normalise. `project-manager-launch.ts:152-156` compares the layers' outputs and refuses `PROJECT_MANAGER_LAUNCH_CONFIG_MISMATCH` on any difference.

**This is reachable, not theoretical: 8.3 is ENABLED on this host** — task-b6cae247's kernel drill obtained a real short name from `GetShortPathNameW` a few hours ago. It fails CLOSED, which is the right direction, so I am recording it as a behavioural note and a follow-up rather than a blocker: the refusal is correct, but the reason code points at configuration drift rather than at path canonicalisation, so it would be genuinely hard to diagnose in the field.
